A handoff is complete when the next person can orient themselves, reproduce the current key result where access permits, and see what remains uncertain.

## Handoff packet

- purpose, scope, stakeholders, and current status;
- README and directory map;
- data inventory, provenance, permissions, and retention notes;
- current analysis path and software/environment notes;
- key outputs with dates, versions, and interpretation limits;
- decision log, open issues, and recommended next actions;
- named owner for the next review.

::: {.callout-tip}
Ask the recipient to perform an orientation walkthrough and one small reproduction check. Update the handoff note with what they could and could not recover.
:::
